title: Trainable Vector Quantization for Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.41822v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Vector Quantization (VQ) is a rapidly evolving technique for compressing Large Language Model (LLM) weights, reducing memory usage, and speeding up inference. However, extreme compression deteriorates model performance, which is challenging to recover due to the discrete nature of VQ parameters. Existing methods employ training-free approaches that are limited to layer-wise reconstruction loss minimization. To address this limitation, we propose TVQ, a novel method that leverages straight-through estimation to enable gradient descent-based optimization of vector-quantized LLMs. By reformulating VQ LLM optimization with trainable latent weights, TVQ enables arbitrary objective minimization. We constitute our approach by applying TVQ in a block-wise knowledge distillation paradigm, which balances quality and training efficiency, and propose several practical solutions to accelerate training. translated_title: 面向大语言模型的可训练向量量化
translated_abstract: 向量量化（VQ）是一种快速发展的技术，用于压缩大语言模型（LLM）的权重、减少内存占用并加速推理。然而，极端压缩会导致模型性能下降，且由于VQ参数的离散性质，这种性能损失很难恢复。现有方法采用免训练（training-free）的方法，仅限于逐层重建损失最小化。为了解决这一局限，我们提出了TVQ，一种新颖的方法，它利用直通估计来实现基于梯度下降的向量量化LLM优化。通过使用可训练的潜在权重重新构建VQ LLM的优化问题，TVQ能够实现任意目标的最小化。我们通过将TVQ应用于逐块知识蒸馏范式来构建我们的方法，该范式在质量与训练效率之间取得平衡，并提出了几种实用的解决方案来加速训练。在现代LLM上的实验中，我们证明了……（原文摘要此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出TVQ方法，通过直通估计技术使向量量化的大语言模型能够进行基于梯度下降的优化，突破了传统免训练方法仅限于逐层重建损失最小化的局限，从而在极端压缩下有效恢复模型性能。
en_tdlr: TVQ leverages straight-through estimation to enable gradient descent-based optimization of vector-quantized LLMs, overcoming the limitation of existing training-free methods restricted to layer-wise reconstruction loss minimization and effectively recovering model performance under extreme compression.
